Hi families,

Today's dinner conversation could focus on what happens if prices drop suddenly, like when you see a big toy you want lose half its value overnight.

It’s worth checking your savings and seeing how they’d hold up in such tough times. Think of it like making sure your emergency kit is ready for any weather.

A simple test: Pick an item or game you both love but could imagine costing less tomorrow. Talk about why you still think it's valuable, even if its price drops.

Let’s keep these chats warm and real. Have a great day!

Warmly,
[Your Name]
